title: Scanpy 原生 batch-balanced kNN 图
bounded_subset: Exact Euclidean/cosine search over a supplied embedding, per-batch quota, deterministic cell-ID tie-break, no approximate index.
input_contract: AnnData embedding, unique cell IDs, string batch labels, metric and neighbors_within_batch.
output_contract: CSR distance/connectivity matrices and batch-aligned neighbor index/distance tensors.
reference_pipeline: Locked Scanpy representation plus locked BBKNN exact neighbor and UMAP graph routines.

verification.numeric_comparison: Exact cell-ID neighbor alignment; distance atol 1e-8; connectivity atol 1e-6.
scientific_invariants: exactly k selected neighbors from every batch
nonnegative distances and symmetric fuzzy connectivity
row-permutation invariance after alignment by cell ID
verification.fixtures: imbalanced batches, duplicate coordinates, rare batches, zero-vector rejection, dense/sparse embeddings

non_glue_reason: The implementation must perform constrained exact neighbor selection, quota enforcement, and fuzzy graph construction.
